name: Shape Sorter Puzzle
description: A toddler's peg puzzle: a tray with a hole for every piece and chunky pieces with knobs to lift them by. Choose basic shapes, animals made from simple round shapes, the numbers 0-9, or the letters of a word. Every piece has its own colour, and each hole's floor carries a flush inlay of its piece's shape in the same colour. Pieces fit their holes at a set clearance, measured on the rendered geometry, and the tray and pieces lay out together on one plate when they fit.
source: inspired by Printables "educational baby/toddler puzzle" (Bas, 761 downloads) and "Educational Number and Shape Puzzle for kids" (hvrkh, 445 downloads)
